proof_body:
by
  intro X _ _ l m hl hm h
  have h1 := Equiv.Perm.sign_prod_list_swap hl
  have h2 := Equiv.Perm.sign_prod_list_swap hm
  rw [h, h2] at h1
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd l.length with hE | hO <;> rcases Nat.even_or_odd m.length with hE' | hO'
  · exact (Nat.even_iff.mp hE).trans (Nat.even_iff.mp hE').symm
  · rw [hE.neg_one_pow, hO'.neg_one_pow] at h1; exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  · rw [hO.neg_one_pow, hE'.neg_one_pow] at h1; exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  · exact (Nat.odd_iff.mp hO).trans (Nat.odd_iff.mp hO').symm
target_source: ∀ (X : Type*) [DecidableEq X] [Fintype X] (l m : List (Equiv.Perm X)), (∀ g ∈ l, g.IsSwap) → (∀ g ∈ m, g.IsSwap) → l.prod = m.prod → (l.length ≡ m.length [MOD 2])
